title: “Sceptre”
html_source:
Sceptre is a horse that Lineman is picking to win the Gold Cup.

The horse race becomes loaded with symbolic importance as the novel progresses. As you can see from this image, a scepter can easily be seen as a phallic symbol and of course Boylan rashly reacts to the “tip” and bets on Sceptre.

Sceptre is beaten by a long-shot (dark horse!) and Boylan tears up the betting slip in a rage.

Bloom finds the torn up slips when he returns home.

It is not hard to imagine the favorite Sceptre representing the alpha Boylan and the dark horse representing Bloom.
